pwaArchitecture.manifest: public/manifest.json; standalone; /dashboard; static launch palette; no service worker found
pwaArchitecture.theme: rezi_theme storage, html data-theme, existing CSS palettes; early boot script plus mutation observer

statusArea.rootCause: Fixed cyan theme-color, white manifest launch background, Apple default status style; no early theme-aware system metadata
statusArea.implementation: Light #f4f5f7/default; Dark #111827/black; Slate #07111d/black. Existing content offsets and safe-area CSS retained.
statusArea.limitations: Apple black is opaque black on documented legacy standalone behavior, not arbitrary CRM hex. Dynamic changes and exact modern iOS behavior need real hardware verification. No black-translucent content overlay introduced.

refresh.pull: Mobile touch gesture at top of actual scroll ancestors; 110 raw vertical pixels to arm (66 damped pixels); release required; horizontal, form controls, dialogs, body scroll lock and visible keyboard excluded; cancel resets gesture
refresh.resume: visibilitychange, focus and pageshow; stale after 45000 ms; successful fetch timestamps; no polling; shared in-flight promise
refresh.manual: Localized small item in existing mobile More sheet; unsupported/new screens excluded
scope: Dashboard RSC via router.refresh and UpcomingEvents loader
Tasks scoped tasks and case lookups
refresh.dirtyProtection: Registered ready checks delay refresh. Case tracks local revisions and acknowledged server version to reject stale responses even if an intervening autosave finishes. Manual detail forms retain conservative input revision guards. No hard reload.

autosave.architecture: One serialized state machine; minimal diff patch; manual Save flushes the same queue; edited-during-flight values drain with the next acknowledged version
autosave.status: Compact localized idle/dirty/saving/saved/error/conflict near existing Save; no per-keystroke toast
autosave.concurrency: Case.updatedAt compare-and-swap in scoped updateMany inside a transaction; monotonic timestamp; status history and fixed important-date reminder writes in same transaction; 409 retains local fields. Versionless full-form writes rejected with 428; existing explicit status-only quick actions retained.
autosave.network: Retains patch and dirty input; error never claims Saved; explicit Retry; 409 requires explicit confirmed reload; no offline storage
autosave.navigation: Flush barrier for Case Back button, anchor/bottom navigation, browser Back and mobile logout; beforeunload warning and visibility-hidden best-effort flush. Framework mocks used in browser QA; iOS termination behavior and authenticated Next integration remain unverified.
autosave.manualSave: Existing Save retained; financial/credentials and other excluded fields require explicit Save; existing custom/reminder follow-up paths remain manual
excludedFields: custom fields and MOS ID (separate API architecture)
financial writes; deletes; imports; organization/identity/password/routing changes
autosave.ordinaryFields: Explicit allowlist in src/lib/caseAutosave.ts: text/select/toggle, service/responsible, notes/personal appearance note, ordinary case/contract fields and server-synchronized important dates
autosave.phase3: Not started; Leads/Clients/Tasks autosave deferred until full Case QA
